verdict.rationale: First-party docs show extensive task delegation to the built-in assistant. Work mode carries larger tasks through to reviewable results, and work can be delegated to subagents. Browser and Computer Use let it take actions, scheduled and event-triggered tasks run in the background, and Voice can start and steer long-running tasks. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of these agentic delegation features (Work, subagents, automations), since community evidence covers only general chat use.
